body_markdown:
SKOKIE, Ill., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LanzaTech Global, Inc. (NASDAQ: LNZA) (“LanzaTech” or the “Company”), a carbon management solutions company, today announced that was featured on the Water Tower Research Small-Cap Spotlight. The event was hosted by Tim Gerdeman, Co-Founder of Water Tower Research.


The conversation provides investors with a detailed look at:


- LanzaTech’s biofermentation technology, and its proprietary processes which turn industrial waste gas into ethanol for sustainable aviation fuel, marine fuel, and chemicals, targeting a multi-trillion dollar global market
- How LanzaTech is shifting its business model and strategic focus from pure licensing to owning and operating its own projects, backed by $500M+ from Brookfield.
- How recent European certification is expected to open higher-value EU/UK market opportunities and create significant market demand
- LanzaTech’s key milestones it expects to achieve over the next 12–18 months, including the first Brookfield project transfer, FID/construction launches on UK and Belgium projects, and initial marine-fuel use of its recycled carbon ethanol.


A link to the webcast of the LanzaTech Global Inc.'s presentation will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website ir.lanzatech.com under the Events & Presentations section, beginning September 16, 2026. The podcast interview will also be available on the[Water Tower Research YouTube page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4IZujgK2avjJwCo9rCMWSsV_wszXXam2s1h8fub0JzttWZLWOyjukMYJmHBqJ2wFPXsoSnZBbEKfwjk5I5mXlMiGW2-resSkhyiXDaRYN0Zd3tRXoZDrb_kY8qygr24OgWHKyj9ssFu3gRyBk_DjI7_DXdwDcQyeiH7nK3TSvXI=) .


**About LanzaTech**


LanzaTech (NASDAQ: LNZA) is a leader in carbon management, using its proprietary gas-fermentation platform to transform waste carbon into valuable products. Through global partnerships, LanzaTech enables the production of feedstocks for high-value markets including SAF and chemicals. Headquartered in the U.S., the company provides technology and commercial pathways that strengthen industrial resilience and unlock new economic value from carbon.
